She paused, listening to the faint rustle of unseen creatures and the whisper of the wind that seemed to carry secrets.

“Why?” She took a step back, the ground shifting slightly beneath her boots. “What’s happened?” Her heart raced, not just from the suddenness of his appearance but from the way he seemed to pull the very air from her lungs.
